relations.zotero_refs: [JUARFJSX]: 71, n. 205 doubts the identification of "brtson 'grus dbang phyug" - the author of (ID:4720) - as sBal ti jo sras, suggesting, rather that the author could have been a student of Phya pa (ID:3831). In that case, (ID:4720) would be a different work from the one listed by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 536, No. 11709: sbal ti jo sras kyi 'dul ba).

comments:
Could be the work listed as "'dul ba" by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 529, No. 11509: sbal ti jo sras kyi 'dul ba).

The author makes frequent references to the views of other scholars, who are not identified by name, but often referred to as "snga rabs pa."
